title: Rithnok the Tormented
summary: Release Rithnok from his torment after Dry Sapara's paladin epic trigger.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: A paladin on the qualifying epic steps carrying the required seal can hail Dry Sapara to spawn Rithnok.
Rithnok opens combat with Harm Touch.
He depops after 30 minutes from spawn.
